notes.title: 1.001 - Epic Skater 2 is now on Steam and out of Early Access!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33092019/4dbed25ad169b8586690c2c04d2badd2bd92bd69.png

Thanks to everyone who has given us feedback through Steam and on Discord!

We're looking forward to updating with new content and fixes.  Here's our first list of patch notes since our first production release:


 Added Training badge to Main menu over Career button for users who haven't played training
 Updated controls menu with proper button prompts
 Added new Old Bro Deck
 Added new Bail reason text and logic for bailing on Stairs
 Edited Training Goals and intro cam text to be more consistent with each other
 Added more BG buildings to training rooftop levels
  Pedestrian animations updated to look more smooth
 Adding (RT) prompt to HUD transfer available icon
 Respawning Stokens on land and bail so collecting stokens in a combo goals can be attempted again after collecting 1 or 2 stokens then landing or bailing a combo
 Removed solid color and switched to outline for bottom panel buttons in run stats menu
 Balance meter revisions:  setting 'red' zone earlier, scaling end pips larger, tinting balance pip with end pips when going into yellow and red, scaling balance pip with end pips


Feel free to leave a comment if you have any feedback or suggestions.

Check out Epic Skater 2 on social media.

Discord
Instagram
Twitter
Facebook

Thanks!
-Your Daily Fill

notes.title: Patch Notes for 0.931 - Production Release Candidate
notes.content:
We're hoping to come out of Early Access this week and this is our first release candidate.

A big fix this week was when the skater would bail in between rooftops in Endless or Career, and the ragdoll would pass through a "failsafe trigger" and immediately force the user to the End of Run screen without giving them time to decide if they wanted to continue that run or not.

3-12's Blimps no longer pass through buildings and we've added some ambient blimps to all the background rooftop career levels.


 New: Freeze camera on ragdoll hit failsafe instead of skip to end of ragdoll timer
 Fixed sound override trigger on some buildings
 Moving blimps added to rooftops career levels
 Tweaked some air vehicle placements in 3-12
 Drop down menu fixes & tighter epic mode cam vertical follow
 Fixed floating QP's and added a missing checkpoint to 3-6
 Fix records menu skater anim


Please let us know if you are having any issues as we would like to launch out of Early Access as early as the next few days.

Thanks!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33092019/9c77e0fc65d24ef30ba20b1fb8b135b64c36819c.png

notes.title: 10 New Career Levels - Our Biggest Update Yet!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33092019/c87185a0dc28c2966f116338ff9dbf5cb79a4b11.png https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33092019/d3a784cdb75e936329ff29994e2890931e49be7a.png https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33092019/e97f0fbff6707e0a3bf575614e1372fd3ff1b637.png https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33092019/d8dd22394c4e090381f7522b0851936ea7657d43.png https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33092019/c9358388a32c026181c1385f3a4e40af99ab35ad.png


We're very excited to bring you 10 new levels today!

Please let us know what you think.  If you complete each level, you'll gain access to a new endless spot so you can get a taste of each of these levels throughout endless mode too.

The three training levels also received new Endless Spot rewards for beating those too.  Before, there were small Streets Endless spot placeholders, but now they are unlocked by default for Endless mode.  Everyone wins!

Patch notes for build 0.928


 OUR BIGGEST UPDATE YET
 4 New Subway Career Levels
 6 New Rooftop Career Levels
 New Endless Spots in Streets, Subways, and Rooftops
 Raised the Endless Goal count from 1,500 to 2,000

 13 New unlockable Endless Spots after completing Career levels in Training, Subways, and Rooftops
 Tweaks to training so there's less space in between walls and rails
 Added a giant jet to 3-10
 UI fixes for wider screens


Thanks for hanging out with us on Discord and giving us great feedback and bug reports <3

notes.title: Endless mode overhaul! - Patch notes for 0.914
notes.content:
Now when you complete a goal in endless mode, it is instantly replaced with a new goal!

You can press R3 to get your rewards, or wait until you end the run. 

This prevents the user from having to stop the flow of an Endless run in order to get new goals to be completed.  


 Added new sponsor to the game: Plain Skateboards
 Overhauling endless goals to auto regen.  Now you can keep racking up goals without ending your run to get new ones
 Removed use drink, find coins, buy goal, and use perk goal types from Endless
 Adding button prompts to UI for all header contexts
 Revisions to new Rooftops drops piece in Tier 1 Endless
 Added new skatespot to Rooftops in Tier 3 Endless
 Fix for some particles showing up as more white from a distance than intended
 Adjusted end of run banger slow motion bangers back to .1 instead of .5
 Added 4 selecteable cam angles for filmer mode, and set to be .5 slow motion


Thanks for your feedback on the Epic Skater Discord!

notes.title: Epic Skater 2 is now in Early Access!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33092019/f59a3c6ac8724c46b7e36df1c315c7d5deaf8f36.png

Hi all, and welcome to Early Access!

Please join the discussion on Discord: http://discord.gg/YAVRyXm

Thanks for following, adding to wishlist, and/or purchasing!  

We'll be updating regularly throughout Early Access.  Here's the low down of our game plan and what you'll be seeing and participating in the development of.

High Level Goals:

 We want to make Epic Skater 2 into a premium experience.
 We're removing all of the mobile free-to-play nonsense.
 No Microtransactions. No IAP. No video ads.  No needless grinding (pun intended).
 We're in the middle of adding gamepad support and we appreciate your feedback
 We are planning on adding more Endless, Career, and Create a Skater content.


Where we're at:
The game currently includes 2 game modes (Career and Endless), over 600 Create a Skater items, over 40 upgrade-able tricks, over 30 Career levels, over 150 modular Endless pieces, full Keyboard and Mouse support, partial/experimental gamepad support for gameplay, a range of desktop resolutions in full screen and windowed, and a first iteration of progression and economy changes to support the removal of in-app purchasing and advertising.

We're looking forward to your feedback and we'll be updating a lot every week.  

If you'd like updates to what we're working on please follow Epic Skater 2 or the Epic Skater 2 steam group.
